connector.name: MCP by memberpass.net
connector.registryDescription: MemberPass MCP - manage projects, plans, members, payments, and analytics for Telegram creators.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.memberpass.net over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace net.memberpass, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <personal-access-token>. Mint at https://app.memberpass.net/settings/tokens with the mcp:full ability.
